title: Broadway Stay • 2BR in The Nations • Breweries
description:
Relax in our cozy 2BR retreat in The Nations, perfect for family stays, friends trips, or Nashville getaways. Enjoy a full kitchen, comfortable living space, and easy access to the city's best local breweries, restaurants, and coffee shops. Just a short ride to Broadway and Downtown Nashville, where you can experience live music, vibrant nightlife, and iconic attractions. A perfect base for your Broadway experience while staying in a trendy local neighborhood.

The space
Step into a welcoming living area where comfort meets style. Furnished with plush seating, chic decor, and bathed in natural light, this space is the heart of your home. Gather around the flat-screen TV for movie nights or game days with loved ones. The sofa effortlessly converts into a pull-out bed, offering extra sleeping space.

The open layout seamlessly connects to the kitchen, which boasts ample cooking space and a breakfast bar with seating for four. This fully equipped kitchen is stocked with all your essential cooking needs and features sleek stainless-steel appliances. It's the perfect spot for whipping up delicious meals and enjoying casual dining.

Retreat to the Primary Bedroom, offering the perfect escape for rest and relaxation.

Ample natural lighting fills the rooms, creating a bright and inviting space for you to enjoy.

Guest access
The Entire Condo is in the guest access.

Other things to note
We are located in the heart of Downtown Nashville, where the vibrant city life adds to the charm of your stay. However, you may occasionally hear sounds from cars, planes, trains, party buses, dogs, other guests in the building, or lively passersby enjoying the area. While we can't control these elements, we hope you’ll embrace the energy of Music City as part of your experience!

Smoking Fee - $250
